provenance.ours: authors' code run by us on authors' data

units: metres; x along wall, y vertical, z distance from wall
estimator: per-frame arithmetic mean of the 1000 particles after resampling (tracking.py saves the particle states; the mean is our summary, matching the root dashboard's 'mean dot')

scene_layout_from_authors_code.coordinate_frame: wall plane z=0; x along wall (m); z = distance from wall into room (m); y vertical
scene_layout_from_authors_code.camera_note: tracking.py: cam_pos=[0,0,0.82] 'depth of camera from wall pre-calibrated (used only for visualization)'
scene_layout_from_authors_code.GT_patch_note: Hard-coded in utils.convert_particles_to_image as 'GT patches' (0.1 m squares, y=0.3). What they physically are (floor marks? waypoints?) is NOT documented in the code.

comparison_ours_seed0_vs_stored.note: corr computed on frames 21-475 (index >= 20) to skip filter convergence
